description:
Price: AU$111.98 | Five-Core DSP Chip and Battery Capacity
The audio mixer is powered by a five-core DSP chip that supports Bluetooth accompaniment. It features an integrated 1800mAh battery, which offers approximately 6 to 8 hours of continuous operation, alongside music-synchronized intelligent light control.
Preamps, Phantom Power, and Compatibility
The console includes built-in pre-amps and 48V phantom power to support XLR microphones, offering up to 85dB of low-noise gain. The 32-bit chipset features a 3-level denoise function. The system is compatible with XLR condenser, 6.35mm dynamic, and 3.5mm microphones, though it does not support USB microphones.
Sturdy Build and Adjustable Boom Arm
The microphone features a full-metal housing to protect its internal components. It is paired with an adjustable scissor boom arm made from an aluminum alloy structure. This arm is foldable for transport and offers 360-degree rotation for precise positioning.
25mm Condenser Capsule and Connectivity
The microphone is equipped with a 25mm condenser capsule and a custom-engineered diaphragm designed for extended frequency response and high-SPL (Sound Pressure Level) handling. Connection to the mixer is established via an included 98-inch male-to-female XLR cable.
Sound Customization and Special Effects
The sound card offers various audio customization options, including 12 types of fixed background effects, 12 electro-acoustic tones, 4 voice-changer modes, and 3-band EQ controls (treble, mid-range, and bass). It also features dedicated buttons for functions such as Elimination, Denoise, Mute, and Ducking.
